# Changelog

## 0.1.1

### Patch Changes

- Publish the real typed NLM client. The 0.1.0 build contained no exports; this
  release ships the actual API — RxNorm, RxTerms, RxClass, DailyMed,
  MedlinePlus Connect, MeSH, PubMed, PubChem, UMLS, and ClinicalTrials.gov
  clients with their types.
